## async - Eliminating Waterfalls (CRITICAL)
- `async-api-routes` - Prevent Waterfall Chains in API Routes - 2-10× improvement (api-routes, server-actions, waterfalls, parallelization)
- `async-cheap-condition-before-await` [HIGH] - Check Cheap Conditions Before Async Flags - avoids unnecessary async work when a synchronous guard already fails (async, await, feature-flags, short-circuit, conditional)
- `async-defer-await` [HIGH] - Defer Await Until Needed - avoids blocking unused code paths (async, await, conditional, optimization)
- `async-dependencies` - Dependency-Based Parallelization - 2-10× improvement (async, parallelization, dependencies, better-all)
- `async-parallel` - Promise.all() for Independent Operations - 2-10× improvement (async, parallelization, promises, waterfalls)
- `async-suspense-boundaries` [HIGH] - Strategic Suspense Boundaries - faster initial paint (async, suspense, streaming, layout-shift)

## bundle - Bundle Size Optimization (CRITICAL)
- `bundle-analyzable-paths` [HIGH] - Prefer Statically Analyzable Paths - avoids accidental broad bundles and file traces (bundle, nextjs, vite, webpack, rollup, esbuild, path)
- `bundle-barrel-imports` - Avoid Barrel File Imports - 200-800ms import cost, slow builds (bundle, imports, tree-shaking, barrel-files, performance)
- `bundle-conditional` [HIGH] - Conditional Module Loading - loads large data only when needed (bundle, conditional-loading, lazy-loading)
- `bundle-defer-third-party` [MEDIUM] - Defer Non-Critical Third-Party Libraries - loads after hydration (bundle, third-party, analytics, defer)
- `bundle-dynamic-imports` - Dynamic Imports for Heavy Components - directly affects TTI and LCP (bundle, dynamic-import, code-splitting, next-dynamic)
- `bundle-preload` [MEDIUM] - Preload Based on User Intent - reduces perceived latency (bundle, preload, user-intent, hover)

## server - Server-Side Performance (HIGH)
- `server-after-nonblocking` [MEDIUM] - Use after() for Non-Blocking Operations - faster response times (server, async, logging, analytics, side-effects)
- `server-auth-actions` [CRITICAL] - Authenticate Server Actions Like API Routes - prevents unauthorized access to server mutations (server, server-actions, authentication, security, authorization)
- `server-cache-lru` - Cross-Request LRU Caching - caches across requests (server, cache, lru, cross-request)
- `server-cache-react` [MEDIUM] - Per-Request Deduplication with React.cache() - deduplicates within request (server, cache, react-cache, deduplication)
- `server-dedup-props` [LOW] - Avoid Duplicate Serialization in RSC Props - reduces network payload by avoiding duplicate serialization (server, rsc, serialization, props, client-components)
- `server-hoist-static-io` - Hoist Static I/O to Module Level - avoids repeated file/network I/O per request (server, io, performance, next.js, route-handlers, og-image)
- `server-no-shared-module-state` - Avoid Shared Module State for Request Data - prevents concurrency bugs and request data leaks (server, rsc, ssr, concurrency, security, state)
- `server-parallel-fetching` [CRITICAL] - Parallel Data Fetching with Component Composition - eliminates server-side waterfalls (server, rsc, parallel-fetching, composition)
- `server-parallel-nested-fetching` [CRITICAL] - Parallel Nested Data Fetching - eliminates server-side waterfalls (server, rsc, parallel-fetching, promise-chaining)
- `server-serialization` - Minimize Serialization at RSC Boundaries - reduces data transfer size (server, rsc, serialization, props)

## client - Client-Side Data Fetching (MEDIUM-HIGH)
- `client-event-listeners` [LOW] - Deduplicate Global Event Listeners - single listener for N components (client, swr, event-listeners, subscription)
- `client-localstorage-schema` [MEDIUM] - Version and Minimize localStorage Data - prevents schema conflicts, reduces storage size (client, localStorage, storage, versioning, data-minimization)
- `client-passive-event-listeners` [MEDIUM] - Use Passive Event Listeners for Scrolling Performance - eliminates scroll delay caused by event listeners (client, event-listeners, scrolling, performance, touch, wheel)
- `client-swr-dedup` - Use SWR for Automatic Deduplication - automatic deduplication (client, swr, deduplication, data-fetching)

## rerender - Re-render Optimization (MEDIUM)
- `rerender-defer-reads` - Defer State Reads to Usage Point - avoids unnecessary subscriptions (rerender, searchParams, localStorage, optimization)
- `rerender-dependencies` [LOW] - Narrow Effect Dependencies - minimizes effect re-runs (rerender, useEffect, dependencies, optimization)
- `rerender-derived-state-no-effect` - Calculate Derived State During Rendering - avoids redundant renders and state drift (rerender, derived-state, useEffect, state)
- `rerender-derived-state` - Subscribe to Derived State - reduces re-render frequency (rerender, derived-state, media-query, optimization)
- `rerender-functional-setstate` - Use Functional setState Updates - prevents stale closures and unnecessary callback recreations (react, hooks, useState, useCallback, callbacks, closures)
- `rerender-lazy-state-init` - Use Lazy State Initialization - wasted computation on every render (react, hooks, useState, performance, initialization)
- `rerender-memo-with-default-value` - Extract Default Non-primitive Parameter Value from Memoized Component to Constant - restores memoization by using a constant for default value (rerender, memo, optimization)
- `rerender-memo` - Extract to Memoized Components - enables early returns (rerender, memo, useMemo, optimization)
- `rerender-move-effect-to-event` - Put Interaction Logic in Event Handlers - avoids effect re-runs and duplicate side effects (rerender, useEffect, events, side-effects, dependencies)
- `rerender-no-inline-components` [HIGH] - Don't Define Components Inside Components - prevents remount on every render (rerender, components, remount, performance)
- `rerender-simple-expression-in-memo` [LOW-MEDIUM] - Do not wrap a simple expression with a primitive result type in useMemo - wasted computation on every render (rerender, useMemo, optimization)
- `rerender-split-combined-hooks` - Split Combined Hook Computations - avoids recomputing independent steps (rerender, useMemo, useEffect, dependencies, optimization)
- `rerender-transitions` - Use Transitions for Non-Urgent Updates - maintains UI responsiveness (rerender, transitions, startTransition, performance)
- `rerender-use-deferred-value` - Use useDeferredValue for Expensive Derived Renders - keeps input responsive during heavy computation (rerender, useDeferredValue, optimization, concurrent)
- `rerender-use-ref-transient-values` - Use useRef for Transient Values - avoids unnecessary re-renders on frequent updates (rerender, useref, state, performance)

- `rendering-activity` - Use Activity Component for Show/Hide - preserves state/DOM (rendering, activity, visibility, state-preservation)
- `rendering-animate-svg-wrapper` [LOW] - Animate SVG Wrapper Instead of SVG Element - enables hardware acceleration (rendering, svg, css, animation, performance)

- `rendering-content-visibility` [HIGH] - CSS content-visibility for Long Lists - faster initial render (rendering, css, content-visibility, long-lists)
- `rendering-hoist-jsx` [LOW] - Hoist Static JSX Elements - avoids re-creation (rendering, jsx, static, optimization)
- `rendering-hydration-no-flicker` - Prevent Hydration Mismatch Without Flickering - avoids visual flicker and hydration errors (rendering, ssr, hydration, localStorage, flicker)
- `rendering-hydration-suppress-warning` [LOW-MEDIUM] - Suppress Expected Hydration Mismatches - avoids noisy hydration warnings for known differences (rendering, hydration, ssr, nextjs)
- `rendering-resource-hints` [HIGH] - Use React DOM Resource Hints - reduces load time for critical resources (rendering, preload, preconnect, prefetch, resource-hints)
- `rendering-script-defer-async` [HIGH] - Use defer or async on Script Tags - eliminates render-blocking (rendering, script, defer, async, performance)
- `rendering-svg-precision` [LOW] - Optimize SVG Precision - reduces file size (rendering, svg, optimization, svgo)
- `rendering-usetransition-loading` [LOW] - Use useTransition Over Manual Loading States - reduces re-renders and improves code clarity (rendering, transitions, useTransition, loading, state)

## js - JavaScript Performance (LOW-MEDIUM)
- `js-batch-dom-css` [MEDIUM] - Avoid Layout Thrashing - prevents forced synchronous layouts and reduces performance bottlenecks (javascript, dom, css, performance, reflow, layout-thrashing)
- `js-cache-function-results` [MEDIUM] - Cache Repeated Function Calls - avoid redundant computation (javascript, cache, memoization, performance)
- `js-cache-property-access` - Cache Property Access in Loops - reduces lookups (javascript, loops, optimization, caching)
- `js-cache-storage` - Cache Storage API Calls - reduces expensive I/O (javascript, localStorage, storage, caching, performance)
- `js-combine-iterations` - Combine Multiple Array Iterations - reduces iterations (javascript, arrays, loops, performance)
- `js-early-exit` - Early Return from Functions - avoids unnecessary computation (javascript, functions, optimization, early-return)
- `js-flatmap-filter` - Use flatMap to Map and Filter in One Pass - eliminates intermediate array (javascript, arrays, flatMap, filter, performance)
- `js-hoist-regexp` - Hoist RegExp Creation - avoids recreation (javascript, regexp, optimization, memoization)
- `js-index-maps` - Build Index Maps for Repeated Lookups - 1M ops to 2K ops (javascript, map, indexing, optimization, performance)
- `js-length-check-first` [MEDIUM-HIGH] - Early Length Check for Array Comparisons - avoids expensive operations when lengths differ (javascript, arrays, performance, optimization, comparison)
- `js-min-max-loop` [LOW] - Use Loop for Min/Max Instead of Sort - O(n) instead of O(n log n) (javascript, arrays, performance, sorting, algorithms)

- `js-set-map-lookups` - Use Set/Map for O(1) Lookups - O(n) to O(1) (javascript, set, map, data-structures, performance)
- `js-tosorted-immutable` [MEDIUM-HIGH] - Use toSorted() Instead of sort() for Immutability - prevents mutation bugs in React state (javascript, arrays, immutability, react, state, mutation)
